input.verdict: MEGNet HSE gap of 2.75 eV for mp-504509 (an Fe–V oxide phase) is above the 2.06 eV photon energy. So the vanadate-rich phases probably absorb 602 nm light poorly. Fe-rich compositions, where an Fe2O3-like phase with a gap near 2.1 eV dominates, are more likely to absorb. I rate this weak support for measuring the most Fe-rich candidate, index 22.

input.verdict: MACE puts FeVO4 (mp-504509) on the convex hull, so it should form in the film. Index 79 (Fe 0.34, V 0.48, low Ni) sits close to FeVO4 stoichiometry. FeVO4 is a known photoanode, but its predicted HSE gap of 2.75 eV is above the 2.06 eV photons, so absorption may be weak. I rate the stability result as moderate support: this is worth one measurement to test the vanadate region against the Fe-rich result.

content.text: Fe-rich (9e-8 A) beat the vanadate region (2e-8 A). Checking the GP suggestion before spending the last measurement.

Index 46 has Fe 0.58 like index 22, with less Ni.

content.text:
I submitted index 22 (Fe 0.585, Ni 0.259, V 0.156). It gave the highest photocurrent of the three compositions I measured: 9e-8 A under 2.06 eV (602 nm) light. I don't know how it compares with the best composition in the library, since 157 of the 160 went unmeasured.

| Index | Composition (Fe / Ni / V) | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 22 | 0.585 / 0.259 / 0.156 | 9e-8 A |
| 46 | 0.584 / 0.220 / 0.197 | 7e-8 A |
| 79 | 0.345 / 0.174 / 0.482 | 2e-8 A |

- **Why the Fe-rich corner:** the model predicts a band gap for FeVO4 above the photon energy (2.75 eV HSE, 2.08 eV PBE), so vanadate-rich films should absorb 602 nm light poorly. The near-FeVO4 spot (index 79) was indeed the weakest. The stability model puts FeVO4 on the convex hull, so it should form in the film.
- **Phase list not read:** the phase list was too long to return, and I had no tool to open the saved file. I found the one phase I used, FeVO4 (mp-504509), by guessing its ID, so the phase-based reasoning rests on that single phase.
- **Last measurement:** the GP model suggested index 124 (Fe 0.50, Ni 0.30, V 0.20) for the final measurement. I measured index 46 instead to stay near index 22, and it came in lower.
- **XRD unused:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so which phases are present in the film was never checked.
